GO_requires_all: positive mean marginal contribution in at least 2 distinct mechanism/config regions
>= 3 unique-win scenarios at eps=0.005 ANWG, spanning at least 2 mechanism families
no mechanism-group standalone regression > 0.030 ANWG relative to that group best fixed parent
max decision overlap with any one parent <= 95%
max reward correlation with any one parent <= 0.985 unless unique-win and MG gates pass by >2x
mechanism diagnostics match hypothesis: accumulated debt decreases without increasing SLO miss/near-miss or KV reserve violations in the targeted region
gains not concentrated: top one scenario contributes <= 40% of total positive MG and top one mechanism family <= 70%
MIXED: Anything between strict GO and strict NO_GO; do not promote to native closed-loop validation without a single diagnosed mechanism question.
NO_GO_if_any: 0 unique wins at eps=0.005 ANWG, or all wins in one isolated scenario
max decision overlap with any parent > 95% and MG < 0.005
mechanism inversion: debt rises while selected service is biased away from debt-heavy/SLO-risk classes, or KV pressure increases in KV-targeted scenarios
all apparent gains explained by matching one existing policy on the winning scenarios

non_redundancy_gate.concentration_fail: top one scenario >40% or top one mechanism family >70% of positive MG
non_redundancy_gate.decision_overlap_fail: >95% decisions match any existing parent on non-tie decision states
non_redundancy_gate.parent_recovery_fail: nearest behavior/reward trace is one parent and no mechanism-specific debt diagnostics differ materially
non_redundancy_gate.unique_win_fail: <3 eps=0.005 unique wins or wins confined to one tiny subset

portfolio_expansion_score_definition.E6(x): max over the current six policies of ANWG on scenario x
portfolio_expansion_score_definition.primary_score: mean_x MG_c(x;P6) on the fixed TRAIN-only screening subset
secondary_scores: standalone worst-group ANWG delta to best fixed parent

stop_rule: If the debt scheduler hits NO_GO, allow at most ONE additional genuinely distinct family from this design document, preferably the two-timescale controller if diagnostics show budget-lag/transition failure. If that second family also fails strict screening, stop portfolio-policy synthesis and return to broader scheduler search outside Family-A-derived mechanisms.
